## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes or relates to.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature or generator (non-breaking addition to TypeBridge)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing schemas to parse/generate differently)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / refactor

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all tests pass locally
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved any TypeScript errors
- [ ] I have added unit tests covering the new behavior/generator
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `README.md` or `docs/`
